# mnemon-antigravity-plugin

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Antigravity%20%7C%20Gemini-orange)](https://github.com/dnviti/mnemon-antigravity-plugin)
[![Memory Store](https://img.shields.io/badge/Memory-Local%20SQLite%20%2B%20Vector-purple)](#)

> **Autonomous, per-project persistent memory and local knowledge graphs for Google Antigravity (CLI, IDE, and Desktop 2.0) and Gemini.**

`mnemon-antigravity-plugin` integrates the [`mnemon`](https://github.com/kernel-core/mnemon) local memory engine into Antigravity. It automatically provisions repository-local `.mnemon` memory stores upon opening any workspace, **consults and pre-loads the repository's active memory state directly into every new chat**, and equips agents with full intent-aware recall, durable memory capture, and graph traversal.

---

## 🌟 Key Features

- 📥 **Automatic Memory State Pre-Loading**: Whenever a new chat or workspace starts, the `PreInvocation` hook automatically consults the repository's `.mnemon` store and injects the active memory state (decisions, preferences, conventions, facts) directly into the agent's context. Zero manual queries required.
- 🔄 **Zero-Touch Repository Auto-Init**: Antigravity's `PreInvocation` lifecycle hook detects workspace repository roots, creates `<repo-root>/.mnemon`, configures `.gitignore`, and provisions `<repo-root>/.mnemon/data/default/mnemon.db` automatically.
- 🛡️ **Complete Project Isolation**: Each repository maintains its own private memory graph. Architectural decisions, bug solutions, and conventions never leak between projects or into global stores.
- 🧠 **Proactive Recall Before Acting**: Directs agents to automatically search memory before answering non-trivial queries, generating implementation plans, or executing refactors.
- 🕸️ **Local Knowledge Graph**: Establishes typed semantic, causal, temporal, and entity relationships between decisions, code patterns, and debugging insights.
- 🔒 **100% Local & Privacy Safe**: Memory is stored on your machine in local SQLite databases with zero cloud telemetry, daemon overhead, or token leaks.
- 🌐 **Global Fallback**: Retains `~/.mnemon` as a universal store for machine-wide settings and cross-project developer preferences.

---

## 📋 Prerequisites

Before installing `mnemon-antigravity-plugin`, ensure the `mnemon` binary is installed and accessible in your `PATH`:

```bash
# Verify mnemon is installed
mnemon --version
mnemon status
```

If you don't have `mnemon` installed, install it via Go:
```bash
go install github.com/kernel-core/mnemon/cmd/mnemon@latest
```

---

## 🚀 Quickstart & Installation

### Option 1: One-Line Automatic Install

#### Windows (PowerShell)
Clone and run the automated installer:
```powershell
git clone https://github.com/dnviti/mnemon-antigravity-plugin.git $env:TEMP\mnemon-antigravity-plugin
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $env:TEMP\mnemon-antigravity-plugin\install.ps1
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $env:TEMP\mnemon-antigravity-plugin
```

#### macOS / Linux (Bash)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/dnviti/mnemon-antigravity-plugin.git /tmp/mnemon-antigravity-plugin
bash /tmp/mnemon-antigravity-plugin/install.sh
rm -rf /tmp/mnemon-antigravity-plugin
```

---

### Option 2: Manual Installation

1. Copy this repository to your global Antigravity plugins directory:
   - **Windows**: `C:\Users\<username>\.gemini\config\plugins\mnemon-antigravity-plugin\`
   - **macOS/Linux**: `~/.gemini/config/plugins/mnemon-antigravity-plugin/`

2. Copy the standalone skill mirror:
   - Copy `skills/mnemon/SKILL.md` to `~/.gemini/config/skills/mnemon/SKILL.md`

3. Enable the plugin in `~/.gemini/config/config.json`:
   ```json
   {
     "plugins": {
       "mnemon-antigravity-plugin": {
         "enabled": true
       }
     }
   }
   ```

4. Verify installation:
   Start an Antigravity conversation in any repository. The `PreInvocation` hook will automatically initialize `.mnemon` and load its active memories into the chat.

---

### 🏗️ Architecture & Lifecycle

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Google Antigravity                       │
│        (CLI, IDE, Desktop 2.0, or Gemini Agent)             │
└──────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                               │
               1. Chat Initiation / Turn Start
                               │
                               ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│    mnemon-antigravity-plugin: PreInvocation Hook            │
│          (auto-init.ps1 / auto-init.sh)                     │
│                                                             │
│  1. Ingests workspacePaths from Antigravity via stdin       │
│  2. Resolves repository root (locates .git / .mnemon)       │
│  3. Auto-provisions <repo>/.mnemon & updates .gitignore     │
│  4. Queries mnemon database: mnemon recall "%" --basic      │
│  5. Fallback to .mnemon/runtime/ projections if needed      │
│  6. Injects active memory state & data-dir into chat        │
└──────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                               │
                Loaded Memory State + Context
                               │
                               ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        Agent Action                         │
│                                                             │
│  • Immediate Context: Uses preloaded decisions & conventions│
│  • Recall:   mnemon --data-dir <repo>/.mnemon recall ...    │
│  • Remember: mnemon --data-dir <repo>/.mnemon remember ...  │
│  • Link:     mnemon --data-dir <repo>/.mnemon link ...      │
└──────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
                               │
               2. Turn Termination / Chat Stop
                               │
                               ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│       mnemon-antigravity-plugin: Stop Lifecycle Hook        │
│             (on-stop.ps1 / on-stop.sh)                      │
│                                                             │
│  1. Automatic Disk Projections Sync:                        │
│     Exports SQLite memories into .mnemon/runtime/           │
│     (memories.json & MEMORY.md) to keep files 100% fresh    │
│  2. Explicit Memory Enforcement Gate:                       │
│     Checks if user asked to remember/update memory.         │
│     Blocks termination (decision: continue) if mnemon       │
│     remember was not executed yet!                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 💻 Command Reference (Repository Scoped)

Replace `<data-dir>` with your repository `.mnemon` path (e.g. `.\.mnemon` or `<repo-root>\.mnemon`).

### 🌐 Global Flags (Supported on All Commands)
- `--data-dir <path>`: Base data directory (env: `MNEMON_DATA_DIR`).
- `--store <name>`: Target named partition store (default: `"default"`).
- `--readonly`: Open immutable snapshot without writes or WAL file creation.
- `--embed-model <name>`: Vector embedding model (default: `"nomic-embed-text"`).

### 1. Store Status & Diagnostics
```bash
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> status [--readonly]
```

### 2. Proactive Recall
Intent-aware, graph-enhanced semantic retrieval:
```bash
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> recall "<query>" --limit 5
```
- `--cat <category>`: Filter by category (`preference`, `decision`, `fact`, `insight`, `context`, `general`).
- `--intent <WHY|WHEN|ENTITY|GENERAL>`: Retrieve targeted intent insights.
- `--source <agent|user|external>`: Filter by insight source.
- `--brief`: Output short excerpts for fast scanning.
- `--basic`: Simple SQL LIKE matching instead of smart ranking.
- `--verbose`: Output full recall metadata, scores, and timestamps.

### 3. Tokenized Keyword Search
Ranked by BM25-style relevance score:
```bash
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> search "<query>" --limit 5 --brief
```

### 4. Inspect Full Insight
```bash
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> show <insight_id>
```

### 5. Durable Remembering
Capture design choices, fixes, and facts:
```bash
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> remember "<insight>" --cat <category> --imp <1-5> --entities "<e1,e2>" --source agent
```
- `--entities "<csv>"`: Explicit entities (merged with auto-extracted entities).
- `--entity-mode <merge|provided|auto>`: Mode for entity processing.
- `--tags "<csv>"`: Categorization tags.
- `--no-diff`: Bypass duplicate detection and force insert.

### 6. Knowledge Graph Linking
Link related insights with typed, weighted edges:
```bash
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> link <source_id> <target_id> --type <semantic|causal|temporal|entity> --weight 0.7 [--meta '{"reason":"..."}']
```

### 7. Graph Traversal
Explore connected memory nodes via BFS:
```bash
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> related <insight_id> [--depth 2] [--edge <type>]
```

### 8. Soft-Delete (Forget)
Prune obsolete or superseded insights (preserves audit trail):
```bash
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> forget <insight_id>
```

### 9. Retention & Garbage Collection
Review candidate low-importance insights or boost retention:
```bash
# Suggest prune candidates
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> gc [--threshold 0.5] [--limit 20]

# Boost retention for an insight
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> gc --keep <insight_id>
```

### 10. Vector Embeddings
```bash
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> embed --status
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> embed --all
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> embed <insight_id>
```

### 11. Operation Audits & Privacy Receipts
```bash
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> log --limit 20
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> receipt --limit 20
```

### 12. Batch Draft Import
```bash
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> import <draft.json> [--dry-run] [--no-diff]
```

### 13. Multi-Store Partitioning
```bash
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> store list
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> store create <name>
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> store set <name>
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> store remove <name>
```

### 14. Graph Visualization
```bash
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> viz --format html -o graph.html
mnemon --data-dir <data-dir> viz --format dot -o graph.dot
```

### 15. CLI & Agent Integration
```bash
mnemon setup [--target <cli>] [--global] [--yes]
mnemon completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression
```

---

## 📊 Category Guide & Importance Calibration

### Categories
| Category | Purpose | Example |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `preference` | Developer preferences, tools, formatting, workflow habits. | `"User prefers pnpm over npm and strict TypeScript checks."` |
| `decision` | Architecture decisions, technical choices, and rationale. | `"Chose SQLite with zero daemon footprint for local graph storage."` |
| `fact` | Verified truths about systems, configs, dependencies, endpoints. | `"Postgres migrations run via flyway in /migrations folder."` |
| `insight` | Tricky bug root causes, debugging breakthroughs, lessons. | `"CORS error resolved by adding credentials: include to fetch client."` |
| `context` | Domain business logic, repository structure, project roadmap. | `"Billing service emits events over RabbitMQ billing.events exchange."` |
| `general` | General durable knowledge not fitting specific buckets. | `"Protobuf stubs generated into /gen via buf CLI."` |

### Importance Scale (1–5)
- **5 (Critical)**: Non-negotiable architectural mandates, safety rules, security policies.
- **4 (High)**: Core patterns, primary frameworks, recurring conventions.
- **3 (Standard)**: Reusable snippets, notable design decisions, bug fixes.
- **2 (Tactical)**: Minor preferences, low-urgency context.
- **1 (Low)**: Transient observations with limited future utility.

---

## 🛡️ Guardrails & Memory Hygiene

- **Store Isolation**: Never bleed repository-specific facts into the global store or global settings into repository stores.
- **Atomic Insights**: Store one clear, self-contained concept per memory node.
- **No Secrets**: Never store passwords, API keys, tokens, or private credentials.
- **No Raw Code Dumps**: Do not store entire files or raw stack traces; extract and store the concise root cause and takeaway.

---

## 📁 Repository Structure

```text
mnemon-antigravity-plugin/
├── README.md               # Documentation & installation guide
├── LICENSE                 # MIT License
├── plugin.json             # Antigravity plugin manifest
├── hooks.json              # PreInvocation lifecycle hook
├── install.ps1             # Automated Windows PowerShell installer
├── install.sh              # Automated Unix/macOS Bash installer
├── scripts/
│   └── auto-init.ps1       # Workspace discovery & memory state loading hook script
├── rules/
│   ├── GEMINI.md           # Core rules for proactive recall, remembering, and hygiene
│   └── AGENTS.md           # Antigravity hierarchical mirror rule
└── skills/
    └── mnemon/
        └── SKILL.md        # Comprehensive skill manual
```

---

This project is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
